title: Cylindrical object
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Begin by drawing the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In this sketch, draw the first circle with its center at coordinates [0.0062, 0.0062] and a radius of 0.0062. Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.0125 to achieve the desired dimensions. Rotate the scaled sketch using Euler angles of [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translate it using a translation vector of [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Next, extrude the scaled and transformed sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a solid body. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object will be 0.0125 units in length, 0.0125 units in width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch on the XY plane
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0062, 0.0062)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0062)         # Draw a circle with the specified radius
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = (
    sketch
    .extrude(0.75)          # Extrude the circle to create a cylinder
)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

# Display the result

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create the outer cylinder
outer = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(0.0062).extrude(0.75)

# Create the inner hole
inner = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(0.0035).extrude(0.75)

# Cut the inner hole to form the tube
r = outer.cut(inner)
